activities.name: Sawnee Mountain Preserve
activities.description: A scenic preserve featuring wooded trails, mountain views, and the popular Indian Seats overlook.

activities.name: Amicalola Falls State Park
activities.description: Home to one of Georgia's tallest waterfalls with trails ranging from easy walks to challenging climbs.

activities.name: Anna Ruby Falls
activities.description: A short paved trail leads to a viewing area overlooking the dramatic twin waterfalls.

activities.name: Tallulah Gorge State Park
activities.description: A spectacular gorge featuring overlooks, waterfalls, and challenging trails descending into the canyon.

activities.name: Fort Mountain State Park
activities.description: Mountain trails wind through forests and past an ancient stone wall with views of the surrounding mountains.

activities.name: Dahlonega Gold Museum
activities.description: A historic destination offering visitors an introduction to Georgia's gold mining history.

activities.name: Lake Lanier
activities.description: A large reservoir offering boating, fishing, swimming, kayaking, and other outdoor recreation.

activities.name: Chattahoochee River
activities.description: A popular outdoor destination for fishing, tubing, kayaking, hiking, and wildlife viewing.

activities.name: Raven Cliff Falls
activities.description: A forested trail follows Dodd Creek through the mountains to a scenic waterfall surrounded by rock cliffs.

activities.name: Blood Mountain
activities.description: A challenging Appalachian Trail hike leading to one of the highest peaks in Georgia.

activities.name: Vogel State Park
activities.description: A mountain lake destination offering camping, hiking trails, fishing, swimming, and boating.

activities.name: Cloudland Canyon State Park
activities.description: A scenic canyon park featuring waterfalls, overlooks, forests, and a variety of hiking trails.

activities.name: Helen Tubing
activities.description: A relaxing outdoor activity that lets visitors float down the Chattahoochee River near Helen.

activities.name: Georgia State Parks Trail
activities.description: A collection of hiking opportunities throughout North Georgia ranging from short walks to challenging mountain trails.

activities.name: Smithgall Woods State Park
activities.description: A protected mountain wilderness featuring forest trails, streams, wildlife, and opportunities for outdoor exploration.
